transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well... my family thought I should come. I just... I suppose I haven't been myself lately. 

Even when my children come over to sit with me, or... or the sun is out on my garden... I just feel flat inside. It's like the part of me that could be glad, or... or comforted by things... it just shut off. 

That's... that's really all it is.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in activities that you used to enjoy, like hobbies or spending time with loved ones?
I... I don't know. I don't really have hobbies. I just... what I just told you. That's really all I can say about it.
Do you feel sad or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?
I... no, I wouldn't use those words. I don't sit around crying, if that's what you mean. It's not sadness, it's just... like I said. Just flat.
Do you feel like your mood is low or depressed most of the time, even when you're not facing any particular problems?
I... I thought I just answered that. I don't use that word. I'm not depressed. I just... I don't feel much of anything. I don't know how else to explain it to you.
Have you noticed that you no longer enjoy things that you used to find meaningful or pleasurable, even a little bit?

I... yes, I suppose. That's why I came. Even when my children come to sit with me, or... or when the sun is out on my garden... I just feel flat inside. It's like... the part of me that could feel glad about those things, or comforted by them... it just shut off.
Have you noticed any other changes in how you feel or function, like trouble sleeping, changes in your appetite, feeling more tired than usual, or feeling like you're not worth much?
I... no, I don't think so. I sleep alright, I suppose. I eat... enough. I just don't really pay attention to the rest of it. I haven't noticed anything else.
Have you noticed any difficulty thinking clearly, concentrating, or making decisions lately?

I... yes, I suppose. I used to plan my meals and keep my calendar straight without any fuss. But lately... if I look at a grocery list, or the schedule for the senior center, my mind just goes blank. I can't seem to... well, my daughter has to help me decide on simple things now.
How long have you been feeling this way — this lack of feeling or flatness — altogether?
I... well, it's been about two weeks. Ever since... since my husband collapsed. The paramedics were... they were working on him right there in our kitchen. It started then.
Have you ever felt this way before, where things just don't seem to bring you any feeling or joy?
I... no, I don't think so. I've always been steady, I suppose. Just... normal. Not like this.
Before this recent period, have you ever had any other times in your life when your mood was low or you lost interest in things for a period of time?
No... I don't believe so. I've never really had that problem before. Just... just lately.
Do you find that even simple pleasures, like a cup of tea or a favorite TV show, don’t bring you any comfort or enjoyment anymore?

Yes... I suppose so. Even when my children come to sit with me, or... or the sun is shining on my garden... I just feel flat inside. It's like the part of me that could be glad about it, or comforted... it just shut off.
Have you noticed feeling more tired or lacking energy lately, even when you haven't done anything physically demanding?
I don't... I don't think so. I mostly just sit in my chair these days anyway, so... no, I haven't really noticed being any more tired than usual.
Has this feeling of flatness and loss of enjoyment been present nearly every day for at least two weeks, and has it been happening in response to a specific event, like your husband’s collapse?
Yes... I suppose it's been about two weeks. Just... ever since he collapsed. Seeing the paramedics in there, working on him right in our kitchen... I just haven't been the same since that happened.
Have you completely stopped enjoying or finding pleasure in all activities, even things you used to like doing, not just when your children visit or when you're in the garden?
I... I'm not really sure. I haven't tried to do much else lately. Just keeping to my chair, mostly... so I couldn't say.
Have you found that nothing at all brings you pleasure or enjoyment anymore — even things you used to like doing, not just when your children visit or when you're in the garden?

I... well, yes. I suppose that's why I'm here. Even when my children come to sit with me, or... or when the sun is shining right on my garden... I just feel flat inside. It's like... like the part of me that used to feel glad, or even just comforted... it just shut off.
Would you say that absolutely nothing brings you pleasure anymore — not even things you used to enjoy doing besides having your children visit or sitting in the garden?
I... well, I really don't know. I haven't been doing much of anything else. Just sitting. So... I can't say for sure.
Would you say that you're unable to feel any pleasure at all in any activities or moments, even ones that you used to enjoy before this happened?

I... I feel like I just answered this. Yes. Like I said before, that's really why I came in. Even with the children sitting there, or the sun on the garden... I just feel flat. That part of me just... shut off. I don't know how else to explain it to you.

Would you say that you're completely unable to feel any pleasure at all — even in moments or activities that you used to enjoy before your husband’s collapse, not just when your children visit or when you're in the garden?

Doctor, I... I really don't know why you keep asking me the exact same thing. I... I've told you. I feel nothing. No pleasure. Not in the garden, not with my children, not... anywhere. It's just... flat. The part of me that feels things is just... gone. I don't know what else you want me to say.
